title: Dissecting the Credit Gap Amongst Filipinos: Why the Gap Isn't Just About Loan Access
summary: For a small business, access to credit is often treated as a yes-or-no question: can the business qualify for a loan? The question is certainly black or white. But what most miss is that businesses don't stay the same size after gaining access to a loan. A business may start by borrowing to restock inventory or cover a short-term cash gap.
